question: Which of the following martial dances is related to Uttarakhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Choliya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Choliya** is a martial dance form that is related to** Uttarakhand.**
 
• Choliya is a traditional dance form that is performed during the **festival of Harela** and is also a part of the **wedding festivities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttarakhand **is a state in** northern India **that is known for its natural beauty and cultural heritage.
 
• **Thang-taa** is a popular martial dance form in** Manipur **that is performed during** festivals and special occasions.**
 
• **Kalari Paittu** is a traditional martial art form that is believed to have originated more than **3000 years ago in Kerala.**
 
• **Gatka** is a martial art form that is popular among the** Sikh community** and is known for its fast-paced movements and agility.
